content.summary: Repair specialists locate and enter a storm-damaged observatory. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One location anchor persists across exterior and screen views. + The vehicle follows the established route. + The monitor confirms rather than invents geography. + The team deploys only after the carrier stops. + The final threshold crossing pays off the original direction.
quick_start.recommended_input: Establish an empty rain-soaked observatory road with one white radio mast as the location anchor. Cut to a weather-radar display that confirms the damaged dome and entry side. Let one inspection lamp lead through the service door and end on the team entering the lit dome.
required_anchors: One location anchor persists across exterior and screen views.
The vehicle follows the established route.
The team deploys only after the carrier stops.
The final threshold crossing pays off the original direction.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Repair specialists locate and enter a storm-damaged observatory. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.
